meta.closureRule: Every preregistered v1 hypothesis receives a terminal classification. No significance is required for closure.
meta.fdrNote: The preregistered BH q=0.10 family cannot be reconstructed as one complete scalar p-value vector without post-hoc choices because several registered auxiliary tests lack preserved Validation A/B features and some family items did not freeze one unique scalar test statistic. No result is promoted; no FDR-based positive claim is made.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Upper strict confluence is a general top/decline rule
hypotheses.fdrP: N/A — support already fails preregistered A/B direction-consistency criterion; no positive claim tested
hypotheses.reason: Validation A is neutral/slightly positive while Validation B is negative. Direction is not consistent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower strict confluence provides incremental buy/rebound information
hypotheses.fdrP: N/A — observed effect is opposite the preregistered positive-increment hypothesis
hypotheses.reason: Raw rebound does not survive same-DOWN and overextension-matched controls.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shallow/deep-reclaim/deep-no-reclaim lower subtypes rescue lower-confluence buy information
hypotheses.clusteredCI: not promoted as separate primary family tests
hypotheses.reason: All frozen penetration subtypes retain negative matched excess.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Common independent XMA state transitions are standalone directional signals
hypotheses.rawN: large; e.g. DOWN->RANGE 301 combined, RANGE->UP 400 combined
hypotheses.waveN: reported separately in transition-path audit for anchor families
hypotheses.matchableN: transition matched controls available in transition summary
hypotheses.primaryEffect: common transitions show small/mixed matched excess
hypotheses.fdrP: N/A — no unique scalar family statistic was preregistered for standalone transition promotion
hypotheses.reason: Transitions remain lifecycle descriptors, not validated directional signals.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DOWN->RANGE or UP->RANGE meaningfully changes the next state path versus same-origin random paths
hypotheses.primaryEffect: A target path 62.3% vs conditional random 61.6%; 49.7% vs 47.7%
hypotheses.reason: Path split is close to same-origin random-path baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAST_MID_ANALYTIC reclaim/loss is a standalone directional signal
hypotheses.waveN: not used as confluence episode count
hypotheses.primaryEffect: both cross-above and cross-below show positive absolute market drift
hypotheses.reason: Midpoint is useful as a fast lifecycle marker but not validated directionally.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confluence-to-midpoint/state timing yields a promotable time-stop/confirmation rule
hypotheses.primaryEffect: midpoint moves much earlier than formal state departure
hypotheses.fdrP: N/A — no time-stop threshold was preregistered for promotion
hypotheses.reason: Timing is descriptive; choosing N bars from these outcomes would be post-hoc tuning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower confluence BELOW_VAL has incremental holdout value versus INSIDE_VALUE
hypotheses.rawN: not available for expanded holdout feature split
hypotheses.reason: Validation A/B Volume Profile labels were not preserved.

hypotheses.rawN: not available for expanded holdout feature panel
hypotheses.reason: Expanded holdout HYS2 features/raw components were not persisted.

hypotheses.finalStatus: REDUNDANT WITHIN STRICT XMA EVENT SAMPLE

hypotheses.hypothesis: Upper strict confluence is a general crypto top/decline rule
hypotheses.primaryEffect: A raw 5-bar +2.95%; 20-bar mean +22.55% but extreme-value sensitive
hypotheses.clusteredCI: four-symbol structure is too thin for strong cluster inference
hypotheses.reason: Sign contradicts universal top interpretation; raw mean is also dominated by extreme events.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower strict confluence provides incremental crypto buy/rebound information
hypotheses.primaryEffect: A raw 10-bar +2.29% but matched excess -6.17%; 20-bar matched excess -9.37%
hypotheses.clusteredCI: four-symbol structure is too thin for strong cluster inference
hypotheses.reason: Positive raw rebound is not incremental versus matched controls.
